fullPassage: The million-dollar question where courage is concerned is whether or not courage can be learned. If fear and courage are to be found at least in part in the hard-wiring of our brains, then it certainly makes sense to assume that there is a genetic component to bravery. If bravery is simply a personality trait, then there isn't much point in trying to learn how to do it better. Fortunately, the research suggests there is hope for people who want to boost their courage quotient. Studies show that people — as many as 82 percent of those studied — overwhelmingly opt to try courage-enhancing strategies to help them face difficult circumstances. Actors who are nervous before opening night spend time on the stage, familiarizing themselves with the auditorium; boxers strut and look angry to overcome the butterflies in their stomachs; people pray or knock on wood or wear favorite pieces of clothing, all because they think this will help to give them a more favorable outcome and allow them to face an uncertain, even risky future.

questions.passage: She washed her <u>face</u> with cold water every morning. The expression on her <u>face</u> showed genuine surprise. Studies show that people try courage-enhancing strategies to help them <u>face</u> difficult circumstances. They want to <u>face</u> an uncertain, even risky future with confidence.
questions.stem: 다음 (A), (B)의 밑줄 친 face의 의미로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A)의 face는 명사로 '얼굴', (B)의 face는 동사로 '맞서다(confront)'.
det.analysis:
✅ ① (A) 얼굴 — (B) 맞서다: (A)는 washed her face(얼굴을 씻었다), (B)는 face difficult circumstances(어려운 상황에 맞서다) ←정답
❌ ② (A) 맞서다 — (B) 얼굴: 의미가 뒤바뀜
❌ ③ (B)가 '표면'이 아니라 '맞서다'
❌ ④ (A)가 '맞서다'가 아니라 '얼굴'
det.tip: face: 명사 '얼굴/표면', 동사 '맞서다/직면하다'. 품사로 의미 구분

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "a natural quality or feature of a person's character"

det.korean: trait = 특성 (사람 성격의 자연스러운 특질이나 특징)
det.analysis:
❌ ① component(요소): 구성 요소이지 성격 특질이 아님
❌ ② strategy(전략): 계획이지 성격 특질이 아님
❌ ③ outcome(결과): 결과이지 성격 특질이 아님
✅ ④ trait(특성): 사람 성격의 자연스러운 특질이라는 정의에 정확히 부합 ←정답
det.tip: trait = 특성, 특질 (personality trait = 성격 특성)

questions.passage: The million-dollar question where courage is concerned is whether or not courage can be __________ (learn). If fear and courage are to be found at least in part in the hard-wiring of our brains, then it certainly makes sense to assume that there is a genetic component to bravery.
questions.stem:
다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로, 1단어)

learn → ____

det.korean: 용기에 관한 핵심 질문은 용기가 '배워질' 수 있는지 여부이다.
det.analysis: 조동사 can + be 뒤에 과거분사가 필요 (수동태). courage가 '배워지는' 대상이므로 learn → learned(과거분사)로 변환. can be learned = 배워질 수 있다.
det.tip: can be + p.p. = 수동태. learn의 과거분사는 learned (또는 learnt)

questions.passage: The million-dollar question where courage is __________ (concern) is whether or not courage can be learned. If fear and courage are to be found at least in part in the hard-wiring of our brains, then it certainly makes sense to assume that there is a genetic component to bravery.
questions.stem:
다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로, 1단어)

concern → ____

det.korean: 용기에 '관한' 핵심 질문은 용기가 배워질 수 있는지이다.
det.analysis: where + 주어 + is + p.p. 구문. 'where courage is concerned' = '용기에 관한 한'이라는 관용 표현. concern → concerned(과거분사)로 변환. be concerned = 관련되다.
det.tip: be concerned = 관련되다/걱정하다. where X is concerned = X에 관한 한 (관용 표현)

questions.passage: The million-dollar question where courage is concerned is whether or not courage can be learned. If fear and courage are to be found at least in part in the hard-wiring of our brains, then it certainly makes sense to assume that there is a genetic component to bravery. If bravery is simply a personality trait, then there isn't much point in trying to learn how to do it better. Fortunately, the research suggests there is hope for people who want to boost their courage quotient. Studies show that people — as many as 82 percent of those studied — overwhelmingly opt to try __________ to help them face difficult circumstances. Actors who are nervous before opening night spend time on the stage, familiarizing themselves with the auditorium; boxers strut and look angry to overcome the butterflies in their stomachs; people pray or knock on wood or wear favorite pieces of clothing, all because they think this will help to give them a more favorable outcome and allow them to face an uncertain, even risky future.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 용기 강화 전략(courage-enhancing strategies). 82%의 사람들이 어려운 상황에 맞서도록 돕는 '용기 강화 전략'을 시도하기로 선택한다는 문맥.
det.analysis:
❌ ① the hard-wiring of our brains(뇌의 회로): 글 앞부분 두뇌 배선 언급이지 사람들이 시도하는 것이 아님
✅ ② courage-enhancing strategies(용기 강화 전략): overwhelmingly opt to try ______라는 구조에서 사람들이 시도하는 대상 ←정답
❌ ③ a genetic component(유전적 요소): 가정의 대상이지 시도의 대상이 아님
❌ ④ the butterflies in their stomachs(속의 나비): 권투선수의 긴장 표현으로 시도 대상이 아님

questions.passage: The million-dollar question where courage is concerned is whether or not courage can be learned. If fear and courage are to be found at least in part in the hard-wiring of our brains, then it certainly makes sense to assume that there is a genetic component to bravery. If bravery is simply a personality trait, then there isn't much point in trying to learn how to do it better. Fortunately, the research suggests there is hope for people who want to boost their courage quotient. Studies show that people — as many as 82 percent of those studied — overwhelmingly opt to try courage-enhancing strategies to help them face difficult circumstances. Actors who are nervous before opening night spend time on the stage, familiarizing themselves with the auditorium; boxers strut and look angry to overcome the butterflies in their stomachs; people pray or knock on wood or wear favorite pieces of clothing, all because they think this will help to give them __________ and allow them to face an uncertain, even risky future.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 더 유리한 결과(a more favorable outcome). 사람들이 기도하거나 나무를 두드리는 이유는 이것이 더 '유리한 결과'를 가져다주고 불확실한 미래에 맞설 수 있게 해줄 것이라 생각하기 때문.
det.analysis:
❌ ① a personality trait(성격 특성): 글 초반 가정 부분이지 사람들이 전략으로 얻으려는 것이 아님
❌ ② the research(연구): 연구가 시사하는 주체이지 사람들이 얻으려는 것이 아님
✅ ③ a more favorable outcome(더 유리한 결과): this will help to give them ______라는 구조에서 전략의 목적 ←정답
❌ ④ the million-dollar question(핵심 질문): 글 도입부 표현이지 전략의 목적이 아님
det.tip: favorable outcome = 유리한 결과 (outcome = 결과, 성과)
